title: Spring Data JPA & Hibernate
intro: JPA and Hibernate are how Spring Boot applications talk to relational databases, and interviewers at every level test your ORM fundamentals. Freshers are expected to map entities, define relationships, write derived queries, and understand the N+1 problem. This module covers everything from @Entity basics to @Transactional behaviour — the knowledge that distinguishes a developer who can query a database from one who understands what the ORM is actually doing.
